svg.title: F-01 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-01 Localise the vehicle on the HD map. M01 No function: Pose lost without detection; control continues on dead reckoning and the vehicle drifts out of its lane (H-04). M02 Stops functioning: Localisation stops mid-trip; same as no function (H-04, rated as M01). M04 Function stuck: Pose frozen while the vehicle moves; the controller steers for a road it has already left (H-04). M05 Excessive function: Lateral pose error beyond the lane margin; the vehicle drives off its lane (H-04). M06 Partial function: A smaller pose error; bounded by M05 (H-04, rated as M05). M08 Functions late: Pose behind the true position along the road; the vehicle stops past the stop line or crosswalk edge (H-06). M11 Delayed: Latency makes the pose lag; same as functions late (H-06, rated as M08). M12 Inverse function: Heading mirrored or reversed; a gross pose error, rated as M05 (H-04, rated as M05). M13 Erratic or intermittent: Pose jumps between estimates; at its largest jump the same as M05 (H-04, rated as M05).
svg.text: F-01 Localise the vehicle on the HD map: what each malfunction does
